Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter - Petition No. 2215/2020

Dear Ms. Kulkarni,

Thank you for meeting us on 2 January 2021 about your dispute with Harish Jadhav. As we understand it, the couple has a young child. The matter is listed before the Family Court at Coimbatore.

Our advice is to agree a joint parenting plan before the second motion. Please collect the school records of the child and the draft parenting plan and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan
